description: Sandbox layer, Docker API filter and egress rendering (PLAN.md items 12-15). Implements the root Docker API filter with the complete create specification (DESIGN §10.8, incl. R4-N5 Cmd/profile binding), sandboxd with the JobSpec API, fixed docker argv templates, stage-in/snapshot/run/collect lifecycle, /28 subnet allocation, Kiro key output scanning and the safety-probe gate (§10.2-10.6, §10.9), the stdlib sandbox tools (ossbot-execd, ossbot-exec-mcp relay, split coder §10.4), every remaining entrypoint script, the full/llm/proxy Dockerfiles (kiro-cli 2.32.0 headless only in sandbox-llm), baked Kiro settings, probe fixture repo, and the renderers for squid.conf and the ossbot-firewall iptables chains with --apply/--check (§11). Everything here is unit-tested without Docker; Docker-backed smoke tests run in FEAT-004. Depends on FEAT-001 (control flags, catalog API, snapshot) and FEAT-002 (gitcmd, package entrypoints).

findings: VERIFIED 2026-10-17 (ADR-0005 implementation addendum, web + live probes): Docker 29 keeps iptables as the default firewall backend; nftables is experimental and has no DOCKER-USER, so daemon.json must set "firewall-backend": "iptables" (FEAT-004 then checks iptables -S DOCKER-USER). The host reaches unpublished ports of containers on a user bridge (no -p fallback). The embedded DNS forwards from the container netns and never for internal-only networks (CVE-2024-29018 fix); with --dns 127.0.0.1 external names never resolve. LIVE: the WSL resolver 10.255.255.254 sits on the distro's lo, so proxy DNS hits INPUT and the two OSSBOT-IN DNS ACCEPTs (before the DROPs) are load-bearing. Fresh Docker 29 installs use the containerd image store, so local builds have a digest usable as ossbot/<image>@sha256:<d>. squid 6.14-0ubuntu0.24.04.4 (noble-updates) pinned in the proxy image; the rendered squid.conf passed the real 6.14 binary's squid -k parse (package extracted to /tmp, not installed; only warning: via off). iptables in the distro is 1.8.10 (nf_tables); every rendered chain was loaded into an unreferenced scratch chain and read back with -S: --check normalizes the extra -m udp/tcp, /32 and --reject-with icmp-port-unreachable, and treats any other token as drift. ubuntu:24.04 index digest sha256:68ee2200...33ac and mise v2026.10.13 (sha256 b775d3fe...8fec) added to versions.lock with sources. PENDING LIVE PROBE (needs Docker, FEAT-004): copy-up owners/modes S-perm-1 (rw-first and ro-snapshot-first), archive HEAD/PUT into a created container on a read-only rootfs, --workdir /home/agent/cwd inside the tmpfs (kiro.sh/list_models.sh mkdir+cd themselves anyway), exec in --tmpfs, proxy attached to 10 networks, the corpus re-record (§23 item 15: check what docker create sends for AttachStdout/AttachStderr, ConsoleSize, CapDrop normalization and the network-create/connect bodies; the hand-built corpus is tests/unit/dockerfilter/corpus/allow.json + deny.json and the CLI model is src/ossbot/sandboxd/runtime/cli_model.py, which FakeRuntime and the tests run through rules.decide), the kiro-cli headless tarball layout (llm Dockerfile copies the directory holding the executable kiro-cli to /opt/kiro-cli/bin and fails the build unless kiro-cli --version prints the pin). Needs KIRO_API_KEY: the five safety probes, list_models output schema, exact V3 tool ids in profiles.TRUST_TOOLS (§23 item 5), the stream-json event schema (probes.parse_events is tolerant and fails closed on anything it cannot read). WHAT FEAT-004 PROVISIONING MUST DO: (1) images step: docker build -f sandbox/images/{full,llm,proxy}/Dockerfile <repo root as context> (llm: --build-arg KIRO_CLI_URL/KIRO_CLI_SHA256 from kiro_cli.*); write images.sandbox_full/sandbox_llm/proxy.digest ("sha256:<64hex>") plus images.sandbox_llm.kiro_cli_version, agent_configs_sha256 = python -m ossbot.sandboxd.probes hash-agents .kiro/agents sandbox/kiro/settings/permissions.yaml, settings_sha256 = ... hash-settings sandbox/kiro/settings/cli.json into config/versions.lock.yaml, then install a root:root 0644 copy at /etc/ossbot/versions.lock.yaml: the Docker filter (allowlist, re-read per request) and sandboxd (image refs, probe tuple) read only that copy; while digests are 'pending' every create is refused (image_digest) and sandboxd fails every job. (2) dockerfilter unit (root): ossbot-dockerfilter --listen /run/ossbot/docker-filter.sock --docker /var/run/docker.sock --control-dir /var/lib/ossbot/control --images-lock /etc/ossbot/versions.lock.yaml; socket root:ossdock 0660; ossbox in ossdock; refuses create/start while killed or paused. (3) sandboxd unit (User=ossbox): ossbot-sandboxd; KIRO_API_KEY from the sandbox secret env; writable /srv/ossbot/sandboxd (sandboxd.db, staging/, docker-config/ = DOCKER_CONFIG, override with OSSBOT_DOCKER_CONFIG), /srv/ossbot/artifacts and /srv/ossbot/logs/runs; reads /srv/ossbot/config-snapshot/current (kiro_trust_mode) and the gatekeeper socket (ossapi); socket /run/ossbot/sandboxd.sock group osssbx 0660; callers allowed: root + ossrunner (peer uid); runner inputs must live under /srv/ossbot/runner or /srv/ossbot/artifacts; docker CLI at /usr/bin/docker. (4) proxy: python -I -m ossbot.ctl.render squid --out /etc/ossbot/proxy/squid.conf (default --template /opt/ossbot/app/sandbox/proxy/squid.conf.j2, so app deploy must also rsync sandbox/proxy/, or pass --template); run ossbot-proxy as root from ossbot/proxy with --network ossbot-egress --ip 10.212.0.2 --sysctl net.ipv4.ip_forward=0, the conf mounted ro at /etc/squid/squid.conf and /srv/ossbot/logs/proxy at /var/log/squid, no published ports; access.log must be readable by ossbox (the workspace probe reads /srv/ossbot/logs/proxy/access.log and fails closed otherwise). (5) firewall: install scripts/bin/ossbot-firewall as /opt/ossbot/bin/ossbot-firewall 0755 (git mode is 100644 like every script; it execs /opt/ossbot/app/.venv/bin/python -I -m ossbot.ctl.render firewall); ossbot-firewall.service = --apply --part host (before Docker), ossbot-firewall-docker.service = --apply --part docker (BindsTo/PartOf docker); every ExecStartPre and the watchdog use --check (default --part all; exit 0 ok, 1 drift incl. firewall_drift:resolver_changed, 2 render/env error, so --check fails until Docker created DOCKER-USER). Exact rendered order = tests/unit/ctl/golden/iptables.rules: iptables OSSBOT-IN (udp53 ACCEPT, tcp53 ACCEPT, 10.213.0.0/16 DROP, 10.212.0.0/24 NEW DROP) <- INPUT pos 1; OSSBOT-OUT (ossrunner 3140/lo/REJECT, hermes 3141/lo/REJECT, gatekeeper 3150/lo/REJECT, ossbox lo/REJECT, ossnobody lo/REJECT) <- OUTPUT pos 1; ip6tables OSSBOT-OUT (same five uids: lo ACCEPT, DROP) <- OUTPUT; ip6tables OSSBOT-FWD (DROP -i/-o docker0, br-+) <- FORWARD; iptables OSSBOT-FWD (-s 10.213.0.0/16 ! -d 10.213.0.0/16 DROP) <- DOCKER-USER pos 1. --apply deletes every existing jump and inserts one at position 1 (deterministic); uids are resolved numerically (all five accounts must exist). API FOR FEAT-006 (runner): POST /v1/jobs JobSpec {run_id ^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9_-]{0,30}$, cid c_XXXXXXXXXX | sys-catalog, profile fetch|research|coder|validate|package|catalog (stack -> 400), entrypoint, args (extra=forbid per entrypoint: fetch {repo, base_ref?, base_sha? (needs base_ref), clone_depth}; kiro {role, prompt_file, agent?, model, effort}; validate {plan_file = /io/input/<name>.json {commands: [{name, cmd, timeout_s}]}}; package {rev, round_base, package_ts, name, email}; unbundle {mode, bundle_ref, checkout_sha, rev}; list_models {}), repo_mode (vetter/summarizer none, planner/reviewer snapshot, coder/fetch/validate/package rw, catalog none), inputs {flat name: absolute path}, timeout_s <= profile max (fetch/research 3600, coder/validate 7200, package 900, catalog 300), cpus <= 8, memory_mb 64..6144} -> 202 job row {run_id, cid, profile, entrypoint, state queued|running|succeeded|failed|cancelled, exit_code, error_class, artifact_dir, created_at, finished_at}; errors {error, detail}: 400 bad_spec|unknown_model|bad_input|bad_id, 409 cid_busy|run_id_exists|not_terminal, 423 paused|killed|safety_probe_missing. Job error classes: stage_in, runtime, timeout, snapshot_failed, snapshot_unsafe (pauses), secret_in_output (pauses, nothing copied, log redacted), bundle_unreadable, cancelled, the entrypoint's result.json error_class, else exit_<n>. Outputs: artifacts/<cid>/runs/<run_id>/ (coder: agent-exec's exec-log.jsonl under exec/), package: artifacts/<cid>/<rev>/ (= the /package artifact_dir). Entrypoint outputs: fetch.json + prefetch-*.log (fetch), <role>.events.jsonl/.stderr (kiro), validation.json + logs/<name>.log (validate), models.json (list_models), result.json everywhere. Also GET /v1/jobs/{id}, /logs?tail=, DELETE (cancel), POST /v1/tasks/{cid}/destroy (gatekeeper state must be terminal), GET /v1/health, POST /v1/probes/run {models: {planner, coder}} (both must be in the catalog; 409 images_not_pinned while the lock copy lacks digests/hashes), GET /v1/probes/status {probe_key, trust_mode, probes, all_passed}. FakeRuntime (src/ossbot/sandboxd/runtime/fake.py) validates every create, volume, network and archive call through dockerfilter.rules and runs per-entrypoint handlers, for the FEAT-006 e2e suite. DEVIATIONS (all recorded in the ADR-0005 addendum): bundle key scan inflates the thin pack itself instead of git bundle unbundle (prerequisite unavailable to sandboxd); HEAD archive allowed; image bound to profile and /in, /snap bound to stage-in/snapshot (stricter); AttachStdout/AttachStderr bools and ConsoleSize [0,0] tolerated; digest allowlist from /etc/ossbot/versions.lock.yaml instead of the config snapshot; job args as OSSBOT_ARG_* env (package.sh/unbundle.sh accept both); agent-exec own out volume ossbot-out-<run>-exec; ip6tables FWD chain added; policy.yaml sandbox.kiro_trust_mode added (ids default). New import-linter contract: sandbox_tools import nothing from ossbot (stdlib only). TESTS: 1417 unit + 26 telegram pass (pytest -m unit ~13 min on drvfs); ruff, ruff format, mypy (95 files), lint-imports (4 contracts), shellcheck (sandbox/entrypoints/*.sh, scripts/bin/*, sandbox/fixtures/build-probe-tar.sh) clean.
